+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+from .shell_completion import split_arg_string
+from .shell_completion import ZshComplete
+
+
+class AlternateZshWordVariable(ZshComplete):
+    """Shell completion for Zsh that reads the command line words from
+    the ``SUGGEST_WORDS`` environment variable instead of
+    ``COMP_WORDS``.
+    """
+
+    def get_completion_args(self) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+        cwords = split_arg_string(os.environ["SUGGEST_WORDS"])
+        cword = int(os.environ["COMP_CWORD"])
+        args = cwords[1:cword]
+
+        try:
+            incomplete = cwords[cword]
+        except IndexError:
+            incomplete = ""
+
+        return args, incomplete

+import pytest
+
+from click.alternate_zsh_word_variable import AlternateZshWordVariable
+from click.core import Command
+from click.shell_completion import ZshComplete
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("words", "cword", "expect"),
+    [
+        ("cli a b", "2", (["a"], "b")),
+        ("cli a b", "3", (["a", "b"], "")),
+        ("cli 'my file", "1", ([], "my file")),
+    ],
+)
+def test_get_completion_args(monkeypatch, words, cword, expect):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUGGEST_WORDS", words)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("COMP_WORDS", "other x y z")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("COMP_CWORD", cword)
+    comp = AlternateZshWordVariable(Command("cli"), {}, "cli", "_CLI_COMPLETE")
+    assert isinstance(comp, ZshComplete)
+    assert comp.get_completion_args() == expect
